reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known strengthening and twinning-promoting effects of coherent precipitates (from FCC HEA literature, e.g., P5, P45) with the dynamic deformation challenges of a specific BCC refractory HEA (P15, P20), proposing a transfer of the precipitation strategy to a new alloy system and loading regime to overcome adiabatic softening, which is a synthesis of ideas from multiple papers into a proposal none of them individually suggests.
